title: 第三章 母子夜谈第四章 天水城内
lines: 第三章：母子夜谈
“姑姑，二婶她就是一个笨女人、疯女人。她说的话，你可不要往心里去。为这种人气坏了身子，可不值得！”，沈玥拉着沈妍的手，轻声安慰道。
看着一脸气愤，如小大人模样的沈玥。沈妍笑着摇了摇头，随即玉葱点了点，沈玥那如玉的秀额，轻笑道：“小玥儿长大了，知道会安慰人了！”。
对于沈玥指责黎凤的话，沈妍却是不加评论。其一，那黎凤说自己母子二人的不是，也不是一次两次了，的确气人。其二，沈玥毕竟是晚辈，指责长辈的不是，又的确不该。只要说的不过分，沈妍也就不想指责，这个如亲生女儿一般的侄女。
闻言，沈玥下意识的答道：“嗯啊，玥儿长大了呢！”。
说到一半，沈玥却是秀脸一变，蕴怒的娇嗔道：“什么嘛，玥儿本来就不小，好吗？姑姑就会欺负人，都欺负玥儿，玥儿好可怜啊！”。
“好好，玥儿是大姑娘。你这个妮子，不要装可怜了，有什么事，就直说吧！”
看着沈妍一副，我还不知道你的表情，反而让沈玥有些扭捏了起来。随即只见沈玥吞吞吐吐的道：“听廉爷爷说，天水城明天有赶集，我想叶重哥哥陪我去天水城赶集玩。玥儿天天呆在家里，都快无聊死了！”。
看着轻品着参茶的沈妍，沈玥咬了咬牙，随即撒娇道：“不过叶重哥哥说，要取得姑姑的同意。姑姑，叶重哥哥都好不容易，才答应了玥儿，姑姑就准了嘛！”。
如果说，沈玥是天不怕地不怕的孙猴子。那么母亲华月，就是会念紧箍咒的唐三藏；而沈妍，就是法力无边的如来佛。
对于这二人，沈玥是即敬又怕，可不敢露出自己小魔女的姿态。
闻言，沈妍看了一眼叶重，见叶重轻轻的点了点头，随即轻笑道：“好了好了，不要摇了。姑姑的手，都要被你摇断了。既然你叶重哥哥答应了，那我就准了。不过有一条，一路上不要惹事生非，要听你叶重哥哥的话！”。
闻言，沈玥满脸笑意的道：“就知道，姑姑对玥儿最好了。”，而沈妍口中的不过，在沈玥看来，不过小事一件罢了。
“叶重哥哥这么好说话，到时还不随了我。终于可以出去，好好玩玩了。”，沈玥满脸笑意的，在心里打着如意算盘。
“玥儿，我还有要事和重儿谈。你就先回去，好好准备明天去天水城玩的事宜吧！”
看了一眼面露严肃之色的沈妍，沈玥只得向叶重抛过去一道，叶重哥哥自求多福的眼神，就准备趋步向外走去。
“对了玥儿，这个你拿着。如果玥儿你在今年九月份前，没有突破到五级武者，就服用了。如果突破到了，就拿去万宝阁卖了，当零花钱。”
虽说丹药能助人突破修为，但凡事有利就有弊。靠丹药之助，固然能够突破，长时间难以突破的桎梏，但以亦扼杀了一个人的潜能，在修炼一途中，会难以走的长远，这也是沈妍嘱咐沈玥的原因。
只是在修为长时间无所进展，看着他人呼风唤雨时。要么留住自己的潜能，要么及时行乐权倾一时，恐怕大多数人，都会选择后者。
毕竟未来的事，谁也说不准。人生百年，短暂即逝，何不享乐一时。
沈妍一说完，就见其从无名指的储物戒指中，拿出先前给沈宇一模一样的玉盒，向沈玥递去。
看着面前的玉盒，沈玥先是咽了咽口水，随即却是摇了摇头，拒绝道：“姑姑，这个太贵重了，玥儿不能要。再说，玥儿又不宇哥儿，需要丹药之助，才能入读天渊府。”。
“姑姑送出的东西，有收回的吗？”
看着微怒的沈妍，沈玥只得收下了玉盒，随即感激的道：“谢谢姑姑，玥儿一定不会让大家失望的。”。
看着慢步离去的沈玥，沈妍轻声道：“恩，玥儿从来就没让姑姑失望过，妮子好好加油。”。
在沈玥离去后，顿了顿片刻，只见沈妍轻声到：“重儿，恨母亲吗？”。
在这短短的一句话中，却包含了沈妍太多的无奈和悲痛，但更多的却是一股坚决。
闻言，叶重却是摇了摇头，轻声道：“重儿虽然不知道，母亲为什么在三年前，要打碎儿子的元轮，还让儿子泡了整整三年，那不知名的药汤。但儿子相信，母亲是为了儿子好，所以不恨。”。
叶重口中的“不恨”二字，虽然很短，但却如一束干柴，点燃了沈妍即将熄灭的心火；如一捧清泉，滋润了其即将干涸的心田。
闻言，沈妍却是盯着叶重的眼睛，接着说道：“重儿，你十二岁就形成元轮。如果三年前，母亲没有打碎你的元轮，以重儿你的资质和刻苦，只怕现在就已经入读天渊府，名扬大赵皇朝了吧。”。
叶重了然的点了点头，随即却是郑重的答道：“名扬天下，能让母亲开心，那儿子就名扬天下；平平凡凡，能让母亲开心，那儿子就平平凡凡！”。
看着语气诚恳的叶重，沈妍莫名的感到一阵心痛和欣慰。
在这三年来，叶重承受了多少，本不该属于他的责难和耻辱；又失去了多少，本应属于他的辉煌和骄傲。这些，沈妍比任何人都清楚。但只因为他的母亲，在他的丹田之上，轻轻一指，只因为他的母亲，要守护他的哪一个嘱托，只因为她信他！
沈妍眼睛微红，随即大声道：“二十年前，一代天才牧浩。在其十三岁时，形成元轮，然后一路突飞猛进，成为叱咤元武的离火尊者。重儿你的天赋，远超过他，如果你再也形成不了元轮，从此平凡一生，成为世人眼中的‘废人’，你恨不恨母亲？”。
叶重依然道：“不恨！”。

Chapter 3: Night talk between mother and son
"Aunt, the second aunt is just a stupid woman, a crazy woman. Don't take what she says to heart. It's not worth breaking your body because of this kind of popularity!" Shen Yue took Shen Yan's hand and comforted her softly.
Looking at Shen Yue who looked angry and looked like a little adult. Shen Yan smiled and shook her head, and then Yu Cong nodded. Shen Yue's beautiful forehead was as beautiful as jade, and she chuckled: "Little Yue'er has grown up and knows how to comfort people!".
Shen Yan did not comment on Shen Yue's accusations against Li Feng. First, Li Feng said something bad about her mother and son, not once or twice, which was really annoying. Secondly, Shen Yue is a junior after all, and it is wrong to accuse the elders. As long as she didn't say too much, Shen Yan didn't want to accuse her niece who was like her own daughter.
Hearing this, Shen Yue subconsciously replied: "Yeah, Yue'er has grown up!".
Halfway through, Shen Yue's face changed, and she said angrily: "What, Yue'er is not young to begin with, okay? My aunt knows how to bully others, and everyone bullies Yue'er, Yue'er is so pitiful!".
"Okay, Yue'er is a big girl. You girl, don't pretend to be pitiful. If you have any problem, just tell me!"
Looking at Shen Yan's expression, I don't know what you are saying, it made Shen Yue a little nervous. Then Shen Yue said hesitantly: "I heard from Grandpa Lian that there is a market in Tianshui City tomorrow. I want brother Ye Zhong to accompany me to the market in Tianshui City. Yue'er stays at home every day and is almost bored to death!".
Looking at Shen Yan enjoying the ginseng tea, Shen Yue gritted her teeth and then said coquettishly: "But brother Ye Zhong said that we need to get aunt's consent. Both aunt and brother Ye Zhong had a hard time agreeing to Yue'er, so aunt will do it!"
If we say, Shen Yue is the Monkey King who is not afraid of anything. Then the mother Huayue is Tang Sanzang who can recite the tight mantra; and Shen Yan is the Tathagata Buddha with boundless power.
Shen Yue respected and feared these two people, but she did not dare to show her little witch attitude.
Hearing this, Shen Yan glanced at Ye Zhong and saw Ye Zhong nodded lightly, then chuckled and said: "Okay, okay, don't shake it. My aunt's hand will be broken by you. Since your brother Ye Zhong has agreed, then I will agree. But there is one thing, don't cause trouble along the way, and listen to your brother Ye Zhong!".
Hearing this, Shen Yue said with a smile on her face: "I know that my aunt is the best to Yue'er." However, what Shen Yan said was nothing more than a trivial matter in Shen Yue's opinion.
"Brother Ye Zhong is so easy to talk to, why don't you follow me then. We can finally go out and have fun." Shen Yue smiled with a smile on her face, thinking in her mind.
"Yue'er, I still have something important to discuss with Zhong'er. You should go back first and make good preparations for going to Tianshui City tomorrow!"
After taking a look at Shen Yan with a serious look on her face, Shen Yue had no choice but to throw a look at Ye Zhong. Brother Ye Zhong looked at him with a wishful look and was about to walk out.
"By the way, Yue'er, you take this. If Yue'er doesn't break through to the fifth level warrior before September this year, just take it. If you do, sell it at Wanbao Pavilion and use it as pocket money."
Although pills can help people achieve breakthroughs in cultivation, there are pros and cons in everything. Although it is possible to break through the shackles that have been difficult to break through for a long time with the help of elixirs, it also stifles a person's potential and makes it difficult to go far in the process of cultivation. This is why Shen Yan told Shen Yue.
It's just when there is no progress in cultivation for a long time and you watch others do whatever they want. Either retain your potential, or enjoy the moment and enjoy the power for a while. I am afraid that most people will choose the latter.
After all, no one can predict what will happen in the future. A hundred years of life are fleeting, so why not enjoy it for a while.
As soon as Shen Yan finished speaking, she saw that she took out the same jade box that she had given to Shen Yu from the storage ring on her ring finger and handed it to Shen Yue.
Looking at the jade box in front of her, Shen Yue swallowed first, then shook her head and refused: "Aunt, this is too expensive, Yue'er can't have it. Besides, Yue'er is not like Brother Yu. She needs the help of elixirs to enroll in Tianyuan Mansion."
"Have you ever taken back the things your aunt gave you?"
Looking at the slightly angry Shen Yan, Shen Yue had no choice but to accept the jade box, and then said gratefully: "Thank you, aunt, Yue'er will not let everyone down.".
Looking at Shen Yue walking away slowly, Shen Yan said softly: "Well, Yue'er has never let my aunt down, Nizi, do your best.".
After Shen Yue left, there was a pause and Shen Yan whispered softly: "Chong'er, do you hate your mother?".
This short sentence contained too much of Shen Yan's helplessness and grief, but even more of it was determination.
Hearing this, Ye Zhong shook his head and said softly: "Although Zhong'er doesn't know why his mother broke his son's Yuanlun three years ago and let his son soak in the unknown medicinal soup for three years. But the son believes that the mother is doing it for his son's good, so he doesn't hate her."
Although the word "no hate" in Ye Zhong's mouth was very short, it was like a bunch of dry firewood, igniting the fire in Shen Yan's heart that was about to go out; like a handful of clear springs, nourishing her heart that was about to dry up.
Hearing this, Shen Yan stared into Ye Zhong's eyes and continued: "Zhong'er, you formed the Yuan Wheel at the age of twelve. If your mother had not broken your Yuan Wheel three years ago, with Zhong'er's qualifications and hard work, I'm afraid you would have been admitted to Tianyuan Mansion by now and become famous in the Zhao Dynasty."
Ye Zhong nodded clearly, and then replied solemnly: "If he is famous in the world, he can make his mother happy, then his son will be famous in the world; if he is ordinary, if he can make his mother happy, then his son will be ordinary!".
Looking at Ye Zhong with a sincere tone, Shen Yan felt inexplicably heartbroken and relieved.
In the past three years, Ye Zhong has endured so much blame and humiliation that should not have been his; and he has lost so much glory and pride that should have been his. Shen Yan knows these better than anyone else. But just because his mother lightly pointed at his Dantian, just because his mother wanted to protect any of his instructions, just because she believed in him!
Shen Yan's eyes were slightly red, and she said loudly: "Twenty years ago, Mu Hao, a genius of a generation, formed the Yuan Lun when he was thirteen years old, and then advanced by leaps and bounds to become the all-powerful Yuanwu Master Lihuo. Zhong'er, your talent far exceeds him. If you can no longer form the Yuan Lun, and live an ordinary life, becoming a 'waste' in the eyes of the world, do you hate your mother?"
Ye Chong still said: "I don't hate it!".
